_about: Calendar-day decision periods for the visa timeline planner (/visa-timeline/). processingDays is the destination's typical decision period in calendar days, used to count backwards from a travel date. Five countries are confirmed against GVJ's own UK visa service research (see data/schengen-uk-centres.json / schengen-uk-documents.json) and carry a note; the rest default to 15, the standard EU Visa Code decision period, with no note. 29 countries total: 25 EU member states plus Iceland, Norway, Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Ireland and Cyprus are EU but not Schengen, and are deliberately left out.

countries.name: Greece
countries.note: Wants fully paid tickets, not reservations, and 90 days of bank transactions.

countries.name: Spain
countries.note: Needs £960 per person showing, whatever the trip length, plus three months of statements.

countries.name: Germany
countries.note: You do not pick your slot. You join a queue and one is allocated, then a short window to confirm. Edinburgh takes submissions Monday, Wednesday and Thursday only.

countries.name: Belgium
countries.note: Two photos, and the insurance certificate must state the covered amount on its face. Policies described as bronze, silver or gold are refused.

countries.name: France
countries.note: Your real document list only appears inside your France-Visas account after you register.
